assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key area polygons are provisional, derived from official text descriptions. All design geometry and metrics must be recalculated when official CAD/GIS redlines become available.
assumptions.impact: Areas may shift by 0.5-2% from final official values. Spatial conclusions are provisional design discussions, not statutory boundaries.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory planning controls (FAR, building height, building density, green ratio, setbacks, road redlines) are not yet available from official attachments. All intensity and height recommendations are design suggestions pending formal control conditions.
assumptions.impact: Building scale and height proposals are conceptual only. Must be validated against approved regulatory plans before any implementation claim.

assumptions.statement: Population figures and demographic structure are based on Haidian 2025 Statistical Yearbook (published April 2026). Talent pool (2.0058M) and academician count (692) are official figures. Local distribution within the 11.4km² design area is interpolated from district-level data.
assumptions.impact: Design responses to population are directionally correct but spatially approximate. Detailed neighborhood-level demographics would improve precision.

assumptions.statement: Climate data uses Haidian Meteorological Bureau 1981-2010 30-year normals. Recent warming trend and increased extreme weather frequency suggest actual conditions may be warmer and more volatile than normals indicate.
assumptions.impact: Climate-adaptive design strategies should incorporate +1.5°C warming buffer and increased storm intensity assumptions beyond historical normals.

assumptions.statement: Cultural heritage information about Jing-Zhang Railway and its heritage park is sourced from public media reports and official park documentation. Formal heritage protection boundaries and conservation requirements must be confirmed from cultural heritage authorities.
assumptions.impact: Design proposals near heritage elements are conceptual and must pass formal heritage impact assessment.

assumptions.statement: AI industry figures (123 registered LLMs, 92 state key labs, 45 foreign R&D centers) are from official Haidian government sources. The spatial mapping of these entities within the design area is approximate.
assumptions.impact: Industry ecosystem proposals are based on verified aggregate data but individual entity locations should be confirmed.

assumptions.statement: Policy directives (15th Five-Year Plan, 2026 Government Report, 'Two Zones One Belt' strategy) are from official published documents. Policy implementation timelines and budgets are subject to government approval processes.
assumptions.impact: Design proposals aligned with stated policy direction but specific implementation commitments require government confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Engineering feasibility of bridges, tunnels, underground connections, sponge city infrastructure, and new building construction cannot be confirmed without geotechnical surveys, utility maps, and structural assessments.
assumptions.impact: All spatial proposals involving structural intervention are conceptual design suggestions, not engineering conclusions.
